description: This file is a shell script for setting up and testing Git repository configurations involving submodules, worktrees, and linked worktrees. It contains various test cases to verify correct behavior of Git operations related to worktrees and submodules.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the specified repository, used within test cases.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that should succeed, executing provided commands.

methods.name: test_expect_failure
methods.description: Defines a test case expected to fail, executing provided commands.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that a command exits with a specific code.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that output or a file is empty, used for validation.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files to ensure they match.
